title.en: Flat to let: from listing to the tenant who asks for you
title.af: Woonstel te huur: van advertensie tot die huurder wat na jou vra
title.zu: Ifulethi eqashiswayo: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya kumqashi okucelayo
title.xh: Iflethi eqeshiswayo: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kumqeshi okucelayo
title.nso: Folete ye e hirišwago: go tloga papatšong go ya go mohiri yo a go kgopelago

chapters.nso: Mohiri o hwetša folete ya gago

en: Open Quick, go to [[Property]] and tap [[List a place]]
Swipe the pictures until you see Property. One tap starts your listing.
af: Maak Quick oop, gaan na [[Property]] en tik [[List a place]]
Swiep die prente totdat jy Eiendom sien. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, iya ku-[[Property]] bese uthepha [[List a place]]
Swayipha izithombe uze ubone Izindlu. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, yiya kwi-[[Property]] uze ucofe [[List a place]]
Tyibilikisa imifanekiso ude ubone Izindlu. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, eya go [[Property]] o kgotle [[List a place]]
Šuthiša diswantšho go fihlela o bona Thoto. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Tap [[Flat]]
A house, townhouse or anything else you let follows the same steps.
af: Tik [[Flat]]
'n Huis, meenthuis of enigiets anders wat jy verhuur volg dieselfde stappe.
zu: Thepha [[Flat]]
Indlu, i-townhouse noma okunye okuqashisayo kulandela izinyathelo ezifanayo.
xh: Cofa [[Flat]]
Indlu, i-townhouse okanye nantoni na oyiqeshisayo ilandela amanyathelo afanayo.
nso: Kgotla [[Flat]]
Ntlo, ntlo ya mothalo goba se sengwe le se sengwe seo o se hirišago se latela dikgato tše di swanago.

en: Tap [[To let]]
Quick then asks the rent a month, not a selling price.
af: Tik [[To let]]
Quick vra dan die huur per maand, nie 'n verkoopprys nie.
zu: Thepha [[To let]]
I-Quick izobe isibuza irenti ngenyanga, hhayi intengo yokudayisa.
xh: Cofa [[To let]]
I-Quick iza kubuza irente ngenyanga, hayi ixabiso lokuthengisa.
nso: Kgotla [[To let]]
Quick e tla botšiša rente ka kgwedi, e sego theko ya go rekiša.

en: Tap how many bedrooms
Just the number. Quick asks the rent next, after your area.
af: Tik hoeveel slaapkamers
Net die getal. Quick vra die huur hierna, ná jou area.
zu: Thepha ukuthi mangaki amakamelo okulala
Inombolo nje. I-Quick ibuza irenti ngemva kwendawo yakho.
xh: Cofa mangaphi amagumbi okulala
Inani nje. I-Quick ibuza irente emva kwendawo yakho.
nso: Kgotla gore ke diphapoši tše kae tša go robala
Nomoro feela. Quick e botšiša rente ka morago ga lefelo la gago.

en: Tap your area
Not in the list? Tap Another option and type it.
af: Tik jou area
Nie in die lys nie? Tik Another option en tik dit in.
zu: Thepha indawo yakho
Ayikho ohlwini? Thepha Another option bese uyibhala.
xh: Cofa indawo yakho
Ayikho kuluhlu? Cofa Another option uze uyibhale.
nso: Kgotla lefelo la gago
Ga le gona lenaneong? Kgotla Another option o le ngwale.

en: Type the rent a month, then tap [[Next]]
Type it as you say it: 12 500. It shows on your listing as R12 500 a month.
af: Tik die huur per maand, dan [[Next]]
Tik dit soos jy dit sê: 12 500. Dit wys op jou advertensie as R12 500 per maand.
zu: Bhala irenti ngenyanga, bese [[Next]]
Yibhale ngendlela oyisho ngayo: 12 500. Ivela esikhangisweni sakho njengo-R12 500 ngenyanga.
xh: Bhala irente ngenyanga, emva koko [[Next]]
Yibhale ngendlela oyithetha ngayo: 12 500. Ibonakala kwintengiso yakho njengo-R12 500 ngenyanga.
nso: Ngwala rente ka kgwedi, ke moka [[Next]]
E ngwale ka mo o e bolelago ka gona: 12 500. E bonala papatšong ya gago bjalo ka R12 500 ka kgwedi.

en: Check your listing, then tap [[Save my listing]]
Saving is free. The photo is only an example until you add your own in the app.
af: Kyk na jou advertensie, dan [[Save my listing]]
Stoor is gratis. Die foto is net 'n voorbeeld totdat jy jou eie in die app byvoeg.
zu: Hlola isikhangiso sakho, bese [[Save my listing]]
Ukugcina kumahhala. Isithombe siyisibonelo nje uze ufake esakho ku-app.
xh: Jonga intengiso yakho, emva koko [[Save my listing]]
Ukugcina simahla. Umfanekiso ngumzekelo nje ude ufake owakho kwi-app.
nso: Lekola papatšo ya gago, ke moka [[Save my listing]]
Go boloka ke mahala. Seswantšho ke mohlala feela go fihlela o tsenya sa gago go app.

en: Saved: tap [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Nobody sees it until you publish.
af: Gestoor: tik [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Niemand sien dit voordat jy publiseer nie.
zu: Kugciniwe: thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Akekho osibonayo uze usishicilele.
xh: Kugciniwe: cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Akukho mntu uyibonayo ude uyipapashe.
nso: E bolokilwe: kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Ga go yo a e bonago go fihlela o e phatlalatša.

en: In your Seller Hub, tap [[Edit]]
Your flat waits here as a draft.
af: In jou Verkopersentrum, tik [[Edit]]
Jou woonstel wag hier as 'n konsep.
zu: Ku-Seller Hub yakho, thepha [[Edit]]
Ifulethi lakho lilinde lapha njengokusalungiswa.
xh: Kwi-Seller Hub yakho, cofa [[Edit]]
Iflethi yakho ilinde apha njengedrafti.
nso: Go Seller Hub ya gago, kgotla [[Edit]]
Folete ya gago e emetše mo bjalo ka kakanyo.

en: Add photos, the details and when it is free, then [[Save Changes]]
Bathrooms, parking, floor size and a few lines. Under Availability, set Available from if a tenant is still in. Keep the street number off the photos.
af: Voeg foto's, die besonderhede en wanneer dit beskikbaar is by, dan [[Save Changes]]
Badkamers, parkering, vloergrootte en 'n paar reëls. Onder Availability, stel Available from as daar nog 'n huurder in is. Hou die straatnommer uit die foto's.
zu: Faka izithombe, imininingwane nokuthi livuleka nini, bese [[Save Changes]]
Amagumbi okugeza, indawo yokupaka, ubukhulu bephansi nemigqa embalwa. Ngaphansi kwe-Availability, setha u-Available from uma kusenomqashi. Ungabonisi inombolo yomgwaqo ezithombeni.
xh: Faka imifanekiso, iinkcukacha naxa ivuleka, emva koko [[Save Changes]]

Amagumbi okuhlambela, indawo yokupaka, ubungakanani bomgangatho nemigca embalwa. Phantsi kwe-Availability, seta u-Available from ukuba kusekho umqeshi. Musa ukubonisa inombolo yesitrato kwimifanekiso.
nso: Tsenya diswantšho, dintlha le ge e tla ba e lokologile, ke moka [[Save Changes]]
Diphapoši tša go hlapela, lefelo la go phaka, bogolo bja lebato le methalo e mmalwa. Ka fase ga Availability, bea Available from ge go sa na le mohiri. O se bontšhe nomoro ya seterata diswantšhong.

en: Read the seller terms, tick both boxes, tap [[I accept]]
Once only, at your first save.
af: Lees die verkopersvoorwaardes, merk albei blokkies, tik [[I accept]]
Net een keer, met jou eerste stoor.
zu: Funda imigomo yomthengisi, maka womabili amabhokisi, thepha [[I accept]]
Kanye kuphela, lapho ugcina okokuqala.
xh: Funda imiqathango yomthengisi, phawula omabini amabhokisi, cofa [[I accept]]
Kube kanye kuphela, xa ugcina okokuqala.
nso: Bala dipego tša morekiši, swaya mapokisi ka bobedi, kgotla [[I accept]]
Gatee feela, ge o boloka la mathomo.

en: Tap [[Publish]]
Publishing is free.
af: Tik [[Publish]]
Publiseer is gratis.
zu: Thepha [[Publish]]
Ukushicilela kumahhala.
xh: Cofa [[Publish]]
Ukupapasha simahla.
nso: Kgotla [[Publish]]
Go phatlalatša ke mahala.

en: Your flat is live
Tenants can find it now. Your name, number and address stay hidden until you accept an introduction.
af: Jou woonstel is aanlyn
Huurders kan dit nou vind. Jou naam, nommer en adres bly versteek totdat jy 'n voorstelling aanvaar.
zu: Ifulethi lakho seliyavela
Abaqashi bangalithola manje. Igama lakho, inombolo nekheli kuhlala kufihliwe uze wamukele ukwethulwa.
xh: Iflethi yakho iyabonakala
Abaqeshi banokuyifumana ngoku. Igama lakho, inombolo nedilesi zihlala zifihliwe ude wamkele ukwaziswa.
nso: Folete ya gago e a bonala
Bahiri ba ka e hwetša bjale. Leina la gago, nomoro le aterese di dula di utilwe go fihlela o amogela tsebišo.

en: Your yield: in Edit, tap [[📈 Yield Calc]]
Type what the flat is worth when asked. It works out your gross and net yield from your own rent. 1T, only when a yield is worked out.
af: Jou opbrengs: in Edit, tik [[📈 Yield Calc]]
Tik wat die woonstel werd is wanneer dit gevra word. Dit werk jou bruto en netto opbrengs uit met jou eie huur. 1T, net wanneer 'n opbrengs uitgewerk word.
zu: Inzuzo yakho: ku-Edit, thepha [[📈 Yield Calc]]
Bhala ukuthi ifulethi libiza malini uma ubuzwa. Libala inzuzo yakho ephelele nenetha ngerenti yakho. 1T, kuphela uma inzuzo ibaliwe.
xh: Inzuzo yakho: kwi-Edit, cofa [[📈 Yield Calc]]
Bhala ukuba ixabisa malini iflethi xa ubuzwa. Ibala inzuzo yakho epheleleyo nenetha ngerente yakho. 1T, kuphela xa inzuzo ibaliwe.
nso: Poelo ya gago: go Edit, kgotla [[📈 Yield Calc]]
Ngwala gore folete e ja bokae ge o botšišwa. E bala poelo ya gago ka moka le ya nnete ka rente ya gago. 1T, feela ge poelo e badilwe.

en: A tenant opens Quick and taps [[Find a place]]
She picks Flat and Renting, then her area.
af: 'n Huurder maak Quick oop en tik [[Find a place]]
Sy kies Flat en Renting, dan haar area.
zu: Umqashi uvula i-Quick bese ethepha [[Find a place]]
Ukhetha u-Flat no-Renting, bese kuba indawo yakhe.
xh: Umqeshi uvula i-Quick aze acofe [[Find a place]]
Ukhetha u-Flat no-Renting, emva koko indawo yakhe.
nso: Mohiri o bula Quick a kgotla [[Find a place]]
O kgetha Flat le Renting, ke moka lefelo la gagwe.

en: Your flat is in her results
With its photo and the rent a month.
af: Jou woonstel is in haar resultate
Met sy foto en die huur per maand.
zu: Ifulethi lakho liphakathi kwemiphumela yakhe
Nesithombe salo nerenti ngenyanga.
xh: Iflethi yakho iphakathi kweziphumo zakhe
Kunye nomfanekiso wayo nerente ngenyanga.
nso: Folete ya gago e gare ga dipoelo tša gagwe
Le seswantšho sa yona le rente ka kgwedi.

en: She taps it: your listing opens in TrustSquare
Rent per month, To Rent, bedrooms, parking, and when it is free.
af: Sy tik dit: jou advertensie maak in TrustSquare oop
Huur per maand, To Rent, slaapkamers, parkering, en wanneer dit beskikbaar is.
zu: Uyathepha: isikhangiso sakho sivuleka ku-TrustSquare
Irenti ngenyanga, To Rent, amakamelo okulala, indawo yokupaka, nokuthi livuleka nini.
xh: Uyacofa: intengiso yakho ivuleka kwi-TrustSquare
Irente ngenyanga, To Rent, amagumbi okulala, indawo yokupaka, naxa ivuleka.
nso: O a e kgotla: papatšo ya gago e bulega go TrustSquare
Rente ka kgwedi, To Rent, diphapoši tša go robala, go phaka, le ge e tla lokologa.

en: She checks your rent against the area
[[Is this a fair price?]] gives a free area guide: the usual rents there.
af: Sy vergelyk jou huur met die area
[[Is this a fair price?]] gee 'n gratis areagids: die gewone huur daar.
zu: Uqhathanisa irenti yakho nendawo
[[Is this a fair price?]] inika umhlahlandlela wendawo wamahhala: amarenti avamile lapho.
xh: Uthelekisa irente yakho nendawo
[[Is this a fair price?]] inika isikhokelo sendawo simahla: iirente eziqhelekileyo apho.
nso: O bapetša rente ya gago le lefelo
[[Is this a fair price?]] e fa tlhahli ya lefelo ya mahala: direnete tše di tlwaelegilego moo.

en: She taps [[Request introduction]] and writes you a line
1 Tuppence is held when she sends it and only spent if you accept. While she waits, your listing pauses for others.
af: Sy tik [[Request introduction]] en skryf vir jou 'n reël
1 Tuppence word gehou wanneer sy dit stuur en net bestee as jy aanvaar. Terwyl sy wag, rus jou advertensie vir ander.
zu: Uthepha [[Request introduction]] bese ekubhalela umugqa
I-Tuppence engu-1 iyabanjwa uma ethumela futhi isetshenziswa kuphela uma wamukela. Ngenkathi elinde, isikhangiso sakho siyama kwabanye.
xh: Ucofa [[Request introduction]] aze akubhalele umgca
I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa xa ethumela kwaye isetyenziswa kuphela ukuba uyamkela. Ngelixa elindile, intengiso yakho iyanqumama kwabanye.
nso: O kgotla [[Request introduction]] a go ngwalela mothalo
Tuppence e 1 e a swarwa ge a e romela gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela. Ge a sa letile, papatšo ya gago e ema go ba bangwe.

en: You see her request in your Seller Hub
Her first name and her message. Tap [[✓ Accept]] or [[✕ Decline]]. We also email you.
af: Jy sien haar versoek in jou Verkopersentrum
Haar voornaam en haar boodskap. Tik [[✓ Accept]] of [[✕ Decline]]. Ons e-pos jou ook.
zu: Ubona isicelo sakhe ku-Seller Hub yakho
Igama lakhe lokuqala nomyalezo wakhe. Thepha [[✓ Accept]] noma [[✕ Decline]]. Siphinde sikuthumelele i-imeyili.
xh: Ubona isicelo sakhe kwi-Seller Hub yakho
Igama lakhe lokuqala nomyalezo wakhe. Cofa [[✓ Accept]] okanye [[✕ Decline]]. Sikuthumelela ne-imeyile.
nso: O bona kgopelo ya gagwe go Seller Hub ya gago
Leina la gagwe la pele le molaetša wa gagwe. Kgotla [[✓ Accept]] goba [[✕ Decline]]. Re go romela le imeile.

en: Accept: you are introduced
Accepting costs you nothing: her 1 Tuppence is spent now. You both get an email; reply to it to talk and arrange the viewing.
af: Aanvaar: julle word voorgestel
Aanvaar kos jou niks: haar 1 Tuppence word nou bestee. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos; antwoord daarop om te praat en reël die besigtiging.
zu: Yamukela: niyethulwa
Ukwamukela akukubizi lutho: i-Tuppence yakhe engu-1 isetshenziswa manje. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili; yiphendule ukuze nikhulume, nihlele ukubuka.
xh: Yamkela: niyaziswa
Ukwamkela akukuxabisi nto: i-Tuppence yakhe e-1 isetyenziswa ngoku. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile; yiphendule ukuze nithethe, nilungiselele ukubona.
nso: Amogela: le a tsebišwa
Go amogela ga go go lefiše selo: Tuppence ya gagwe e 1 e šomišwa bjale. Ka bobedi le hwetša imeile; e arabe gore le boledišane, le rulaganye go bona.

en: She sees it under [[My Requests]]
Accepted, check your email.
af: Sy sien dit onder [[My Requests]]
Accepted, check your email.
zu: Ukubona ngaphansi kwe-[[My Requests]]
Accepted, check your email.
xh: Ukubona phantsi kwe-[[My Requests]]
Accepted, check your email.
nso: O e bona ka fase ga [[My Requests]]
Accepted, check your email.

en: Pass Quick on
On Quick's first screen, tap Share. They get their own Quick, never your listing or your number.
af: Gee Quick aan
Op Quick se eerste skerm, tik Share. Hulle kry hul eie Quick, nooit jou advertensie of jou nommer nie.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Esikrinini sokuqala se-Quick, thepha Share. Bathola i-Quick yabo, hhayi isikhangiso sakho noma inombolo yakho.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Kwisikrini sokuqala se-Quick, cofa Share. Bafumana eyabo i-Quick, hayi intengiso yakho okanye inombolo yakho.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Sekrining sa mathomo sa Quick, kgotla Share. Ba hwetša Quick ya bona, e sego papatšo ya gago goba nomoro ya gago.
